intro: Take a moment to survey the Forge and note where every Stone sits before you begin. Then step through your Autumn turn — the guide shows only the steps that apply to your Stone's current position.

children.label: Pass 1 — Leave Stasis & Opposition
children.body: Each player in turn order (clockwise from the Agekeeper).

children.label: Forge spot open
children.body: Return your Stone to the Forge position it previously held. You may re-arm a Ward Reagent on the 🛡️ symbol beside your Stone.

children.label: Wait — stay in Stasis
children.body: Remain in Stasis another round. No action required.

children.label: Challenge — Stasis Opposition in step 2
children.body: Declare Stasis Opposition on your turn in Pass 1, step 2. If you win, the two Stones swap — your Stone enters the Forge and the Defender goes to Stasis. If you lose, you remain in Stasis.

children.label: 2. Opposition
children.condition: You may challenge a rival Forging Stone, or defend if you are Forging
children.body: Alignment contest — declare Opposition against an eligible Forging Stone. Pay the Defender's Ward Reagent entry fee; play cards; roll dice; highest Alignment Points wins. Defender's Stone moves to Stasis on a Challenger win.

children.label: Pass 2 — Temper & Fire
children.body: After all players finish Pass 1, repeat turn order for Temper and Fire.

children.label: 3. Temper
children.condition: Forging since last round; not if you returned from Stasis this Autumn
children.body: Advance your Stone from the Forge to the next Mantle Ring position. Discard the Crucible Card — the Stage is complete. Remaining Ward Reagents are burned and returned to the supply.

children.label: 4. Fire
children.condition: Stone in a Mantle Ring (0, 2, 4, or 6) — not Forging or in Stasis
children.body: Satisfy an Active Crucible Card's Alchemical Formula (Alignment cards + Reagents). Discard the cards and Reagents, turn the Crucible Card sideways, move your Stone into the Forge. Optionally place Ward Reagents on the 🛡️ symbol to raise the entry fee for Oppositions.
